script_text: Taurus, Mars squares your Sun this week, igniting unexpected confrontations that demand your attention. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in Taurus sextiles Neptune, blurring communication boundaries—avoid signing contracts before Thursday when Venus trines Jupiter in your 5th House, sparking magnetic attraction for your love life. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House, boosting career visibility. Mid-week, Saturn sextiles your natal Pluto, forcing you to transform outdated power structures at work. Thursday through Sunday, Mars enters your 7th House, sharpening partnerships but creating conflict with rivals—channel this energy into bold negotiations. Tuesday brings financial clarity when Jupiter sextiles your 2nd House, perfect for investment decisions. Your worst day is Friday when Mars opposes your Sun, triggering authority clashes at work. Weekly advice: Trust Venus's Friday evening trine to Neptune for romantic intuition. Follow for daily updates.
